label.title: Universal Healthcare Coverage and Access in the US

claims.claim_text: Commitment to build a health care system that provides universal health care coverage.
Support for a national healthcare system like Medicare For All.
Commitment to improve health care access and affordability in the U.S. territories.
Support for health justice through Medicare for All.

Support for ensuring everyone, regardless of employment, immigration, or insurance status, receives the healthcare they need — including free testing and treatment, mental healthcare, and long-term care for people with disabilities.
Support for universal healthcare coverage for all United States residents, including non-citizens.
